name: type5-space-padded-names-come-back-with-at
source: gpsd test/sample.aivdm (BSD-2-Clause), sentences at lines 124 and 125
reference: Two fragments joined in order (71 characters, 426 bits; fill 2). Raw six-bit fields: call sign '3FOF8  ', ship name 'EVER DIADEM' + 9 spaces, destination 'NEW YORK' + 12 spaces; `trim` removes the trailing spaces. Draught 122 x 1/10 = 12.2. gpsd agrees (callsign 3FOF8, shipname EVER DIADEM, destination NEW YORK, eta 05-15T14:00Z, draught 12.2, dte 0). Expect differs from input: sixbit encode pads with @ (value 0), so the trailing spaces (value 32) come back as @ (engine-spec 0.14, The sixbit transform; pack.md, Behaviour to know). L = 424, 71 characters, 2 zero fill bits.
